items.t: There is no Enclave board sub-area.

Containing ground: Grandview, in the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock," City of Surrey. Planning frame for the ground: the City's approved South Surrey plans for Grandview Heights include the North Grandview Heights NCP (north of 28 Avenue, King George Boulevard to Highway 15) and the Morgan Heights NCP.
How people search for it: "Enclave at Grandview," "Enclave Citimark townhomes," "2979 156 Street."

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Enclave at Grandview

items.t: OCP / Zoning — Surrey (Grandview ground): Surrey Official Community Plan Bylaw 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) is current — never cite 18020 as current. Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000 governs.

SSMUH — Surrey: maximum 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; adopted July 8, 2024. This is the frame for fee-simple lots around Grandview — it does not re-zone a strata complex's own ground for an individual unit buyer.

ALR block (carried for completeness — no ALR ground documented for this project): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified; caps principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); farm class three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Strata block (this project's units ARE strata): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ units since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw.
Foreclosure / court sales (where met): settled court process (Rules 21-7 / 13-5, PD-66, Form 60). Surrey has no Supreme Court registry.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Enclave's pocket is the west side of Grandview Heights, on 156 Street inside the Morgan Heights plan area, the first neighbourhood planned in Grandview Heights.
Morgan Heights covers about 80 hectares (196 acres), bounded by 28 Avenue to the north, 24 Avenue to the south and 164 Street to the east, with the Highway 99 corridor plan area to the west.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The pocket's confirmed housing pattern is the Morgan Heights mix: the City plan for this neighbourhood features a mix of housing types with three new neighbourhood parks, centred on Southridge School.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Morgan Heights' land-use rules no longer come from its own plan: the City states the Morgan Heights plan was rescinded through the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP) update and is no longer in effect, and development in the area is led by the OCP.

The same rescission matters north of 28 Avenue: North Grandview Heights' designations have also been superseded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update, so a lot on either side of the avenue is read from the OCP today.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Morgan Heights is centred on Southridge School at 2656 160 Street, the independent school the City names as the plan's centre — the landmark locals use for this pocket.

Sunnyside Elementary was already at 24 classrooms including 7 portables in 2018, when the school district sought a parking variance for two more portables — a crowding marker for this pocket's families.
Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Avenue was built at 1,500-student capacity specifically to address overcrowding in South Surrey and White Rock.
The Morgan Heights plan is described by the City as largely built out, so new supply in this pocket now comes as individual rezonings, not as a further plan phase.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: getting around

items.t: TransLink route 531 runs from White Rock Centre to Willowbrook via 24 Avenue, the crosstown spine south of this pocket.
TransLink route 345 runs from King George Station to White Rock Centre via 152 Street, west of 156 Street, per its timetable.
TransLink route 375 runs from White Rock South to Guildford via 152 Street, a second 152 Street option in the same timetable family.
TransLink route 351 runs from Bridgeport Station via Highway 99 and the South Surrey Park & Ride to White Rock Centre, the Canada Line connection for this pocket.

blocks.text: Enclave at Grandview Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: For a lot near the north edge of Morgan Heights, check the City's sensitive-ecosystem mapping: a 2023 application at 16487-28 Avenue in North Grandview Heights required a Development Permit for Sensitive Ecosystems, which shows ecosystem permits are live on this side of Grandview Heights.

Read the depreciation report and minutes for the specific strata before subjects: strata corporations with five or more strata lots must obtain a depreciation report under British Columbia's strata framework, and disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

faq.a: Two School District 36 elementary schools stand in this pocket: Sunnyside Elementary at 2828-159 Street and Morgan Elementary at 3366-156A Street, both recorded in the British Columbia school list. A district consultation package listed Sunnyside and Morgan among the proposed feeder schools for Grandview Heights Secondary. Catchment is still by exact address, so run 2979 156 Street in the district locator.
faq.q: Which elementary schools are in Enclave's pocket?

faq.a: It sits on the seam, and the plan answer changed recently either way. Morgan Heights runs from 24 Avenue to 28 Avenue; North Grandview Heights runs from 28 Avenue to 32 Avenue, east of 156 Street. Both plans' designations have now been superseded or rescinded in favour of the Surrey 2050 OCP, so the practical rule for a buyer is the OCP designation and the lot's zone, not the old plan name.
faq.q: Is Enclave in Morgan Heights or North Grandview Heights?

faq.a: Northward, following the slope. The City's terms of reference for the Morgan Heights plan state the area drains to the north, following the natural topography through the North Grandview Heights area. For a specific Enclave lot, that means checking the City's ecosystem and drainage mapping for the parcel rather than assuming the street's grading tells the whole story.
